description: MTA Bridges & Tunnels Hourly Reconciled Crossings: 2019 - 2024 is a dataset listed in State of New York open data portal (data.ny.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of New York. This dataset provides data showing the most updated view of toll collections by payment method (E-ZPass, Tolls by Mail, and Unbillable) for each vehicle that crosses an MTA-owned facility. Coverage: New York State. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are hourly traffic, bridges and tunnels. The table has 13 columns. Attribution on the portal: Metropolitan Transportation Authority. The portal shows 2025-09-19 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ny-gov-portal.
